title: Discover the Flavors of Miami
abstract: Miami’s dining scene reflects its vibrant cultural mix, offering an array of delicious food from around the world. Explore the diverse flavors and culinary traditions that define this city.

packages.title: Little Havana Food Tour
packages.description: Walk through Little Havana and savor the best Cuban sandwiches, pastries, and coffee while learning about the history behind the food.

packages.title: Miami Cooking Class
packages.description: Join a local chef for a hands-on cooking class, where you’ll learn to make classic Cuban dishes like ropa vieja and tostones.

packages.title: Slavic Cuisine History Tour
packages.description: Delve into the rich history of Slavic food in Miami with this cultural and culinary journey, featuring stops at authentic eateries.

packages.title: Craft Beer and Tapas Tasting
packages.description: Experience Miami’s thriving craft beer scene paired with small plates and tapas from around the globe in this guided tasting tour.

packages.title: Latin American Food History Tour
packages.description: Explore the evolution of Latin American cuisine in Miami on this food history tour, sampling dishes from Peru, Brazil, and Colombia.

packages.title: Wynwood Art & Culinary Tour
packages.description: Combine art and food on this guided tour through Wynwood, with stops for bites at trendy restaurants and cafés.
